# Outcome of every kind/state/action/role combination (ADRs 0102 and 0103).
# `->state` is the state reached; anything else is the refusal code.
# Each request names the stored version, the first allowed reason, and for
# uphold-report an approved reported item on the same work. Items have
# clarification consent, kept text and a retention period that has ended,
# under the default retention, which leaves comments out (ADR 0104).
#
